title: Pure Nephthys
summary: Nephthys is a Ritual and Link self-destruction archetype built around Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys, Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys, and their 1-card combo starter Conductor of Nephthys! Ritual Summon Level 2 Conductor of Nephthys using Rebirth of Nephthys, and Conductor's effect immediately Special Summons another Nephthys Ritual Monster directly from your hand or Deck (treated as a Ritual Summon!). Devotee of Nephthys then Special Summons a Nephthys monster from your Deck, letting you Link Summon Nephthys, the Sacred Preserver and climb into the Link-3 boss Nephthys, the Sacred Flame—which reaches 4800 ATK and becomes completely untargetable and indestructible by battle or card effects when made with 3 Ritual Monsters!

allow.Pre-Preparation of Rites: Adds Rebirth of Nephthys and either Devotee of Nephthys or Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys simultaneously from your Deck or GY to your hand!
allow.Preparation of Rites: Adds Level 2 Ritual Monster Conductor of Nephthys or Devotee of Nephthys from your Deck to your hand and recovers Rebirth of Nephthys from your GY.
allow.Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands: Normal Summon starter that searches any Nephthys Ritual Monster or Rebirth of Nephthys from your Deck.
allow.Herald of Mirage Lights: Link-2 Fairy made with two Nephthys monsters that discards a card to negate any Spell/Trap and recovers 2 Ritual cards when sent to GY.
allow.Dyna Mondo: Link-2 Ritual support monster that recycles Ritual Monsters and spins opposing cards back into the Deck.

main: Conductor of Nephthys

Core Level 2 WIND Spellcaster Ritual starter: when Ritual Summoned, immediately Special Summons 1 'Nephthys' Ritual Monster directly from your hand or Deck; if Tributed or destroyed by a Nephthys effect, destroys 1 Nephthys card during the next Standby Phase!
Devotee of Nephthys
Core Level 2 FIRE Winged Beast Ritual starter: when Ritual Summoned, Special Summons 1 'Nephthys' monster from your Deck; and destroys 1 Nephthys card in your hand to revive itself from the GY!
Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys

Signature Level 8 FIRE Winged Beast Ritual boss (3000 ATK): destroys any number of Nephthys cards in your hand/field to destroy an equal number of monsters your opponent controls; revives itself during the next Standby Phase if destroyed!
Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys
Iconic Level 8 FIRE Winged Beast boss (2400 ATK): if destroyed by card effect, Special Summons itself from GY during your next Standby Phase and destroys ALL Spell and Trap Cards on the field!
Disciple of Nephthys

Level 2 WIND Spellcaster: destroys 1 card in your hand during your Main Phase to search any 'Nephthys' monster from your Deck, and searches a Nephthys Spell/Trap during the next Standby Phase if destroyed.
Chronicler of Nephthys
Level 2 WIND Spellcaster: targets 1 'Nephthys' card in your GY, destroys 1 card in your hand, and adds that target to your hand; recovers a Nephthys card during the next Standby Phase if destroyed.
Matriarch of Nephthys
Level 2 WIND Spellcaster: destroys 1 card in hand to revive a Level 4 or lower Nephthys monster from your GY.
Chaos Nephthys

Level 8 DARK Winged Beast boss: Special Summons itself from hand or GY when a card on the field is destroyed by card effect by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK, then banishes 1 card your opponent controls and 2 from their GY!
Rebirth of Nephthys

Core Ritual Spell: tributes monsters from hand or field to Ritual Summon any 'Nephthys' Ritual Monster; and if you Tributed 'Devotee' or 'Cerulean', you can also destroy 1 card on the field WITHOUT targeting!
Last Hope of Nephthys
Destroys 1 other 'Nephthys' card you control and 1 card your opponent controls.
Awakening of Nephthys
Continuous Trap that boosts all Nephthys monsters by 300 ATK and Special Summons any Winged Beast or Spellcaster if destroyed.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Searches Rebirth of Nephthys AND either Devotee of Nephthys or Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys simultaneously!
Preparation of Rites
Searches Level 2 Conductor of Nephthys or Devotee of Nephthys and recovers Rebirth of Nephthys from your GY.
Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
Normal Summon starter that searches any Nephthys Ritual Monster or Rebirth of Nephthys directly from your Deck.
extra: Signature Link-3 FIRE Winged Beast boss: gains up to 4800 ATK, battle/effect destruction immunity, and targeting immunity based on the number of Ritual Monsters used for its Link Summon!

Signature Link-2 FIRE Winged Beast: adds 1 Level 8 Winged Beast from Deck to hand and recovers a Ritual Spell from GY, OR destroys 1 Nephthys monster and revives another with a different name from GY!
Link-2 Fairy that negates Spells/Traps and recovers 2 Ritual cards when sent to the GY.
Link-2 Ritual support monster that recycles Ritual Monsters and spins opposing cards back into the Deck.
